name: Aholiab
overview: Scripture presents Aholiab as a gifted artisan chosen by God to assist in the construction of the tabernacle, endowed with wisdom and skill for intricate craftsmanship. As the son of Ahisamach from the tribe of Dan, he was empowered by the Lord to teach and work alongside Bezaleel and other skilled craftsmen, contributing to the sanctuary's service through engraving, embroidery, and other fine workmanship. His role exemplifies how God equips His people with specific talents to fulfill His holy purposes.
